name: Notice
summary: A message on the page with an icon and words, so colour is never the only signal: info, success, error, or automated (something the system worked out or filled in). The four failures use locked copy and are counted.

when: To say something about the page or what just happened.
For the four failures: network, too many attempts, session expired and provider unavailable.

whenNot.text: For a short confirmation that needs no action.

anatomy.description: What happened, and what to do.

props.name: tone
props.description: What kind of message it is.

values.description: Something the system worked out or filled in.

props.name: failure
props.description: One of the four failures, with its locked copy. Sets the tone, and sends doras.failure_shown.

values.description: Not a failure: the message is in the slot.
The network failed. What was typed is kept.
Too many tries, with a clear wait. Never says whether an account exists.
The session expired; it starts again without losing context.
The provider isn't answering. It doesn't blame the person or the app.

props.name: minutes
props.description: How long to wait, for too-many-attempts.

states.name: Info, success, error, automated
states.description: Each with its own colours and icon.

states.name: Failure
states.description: One of the four failures, in its locked words.

events.name: doras.failure_shown
events.when: A failure notice is shown. Each failure is counted once per notice.

accessibility.name: None.

keyboard.action: Moves to any actions inside it.

screenReader: Read in place, with its icon hidden.
announcements: Notices aren't announced by themselves. To have a new one heard, also announce it through the Announcer.

related.relationship: To have a new notice heard.
For confirmations that need no action.

guidelines: Say what happened, then what to do.
Failures never blame the person, and never say whether an account exists.

dosAndDonts.do: Pair the colour with an icon and words.

evidence.point: Failure copy never reveals whether an account exists, so the door can't be used to find accounts.

slots.description: The message, when it isn't a failure.
